## Local model provenance

Model artifacts are never downloaded by the generator. A `pending` bundle records that no local bundle was supplied; every normal generation/check accepts a `verified` bundle only after independently reading its local files and matching the recorded module name, revision, and SHA-256 digest.

| Bundle | Disposition | Recorded modules | Findings |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `local_yang_snapshot` | `pending` | — | No local YANG/model bundle was supplied; module revisions and digests remain explicitly unverified. |
